Name: Pineapple Express
Tasting_Notes: pineapple, it carries the spirit of tropical innovation in every sip
Desc: Pineapple Express - 2025 Harvest Pineapple Fermentation | Microlot Series Welcome to the cutting edge of Indian specialty coffee. Pineapple Express is a bold and vibrant microlot crafted at Barbara Estate , nestled in the highlands of Baba Budangiri, Chikmagalur . Grown at an elevation of 1550m and fermented using ripe pineapple, this coffee is the result of pioneering post-harvest innovation - an experiment in flavor that delivers a one-of-a-kind sensory experience. This medium roast 100% Arabica coffee opens with a winey acidity and sweet dried fruit aroma , evolving into notes of apple, dried mango, vanilla, and caramel , with a whisper of spice and a refined, spirit-like finish. It's the perfect harmony of brightness and sweetness - delightfully unexpected, yet beautifully balanced. Whether you brew it as espresso, French press, moka pot, or cold brew, Pineapple Express is a journey worth taking. Why Pineapple Fermentation? The pineapple not only contributes natural sugars and microbial diversity to enhance fermentation, but it also accelerates mucilage breakdown, ensuring a cleaner drying process and a mold-free bean. The result is a coffee bursting with flavor, though it doesn’t taste like pineapple, it carries the spirit of tropical innovation in every sip.

Name: Bubble Bliss - Anaerobic Fermented
Tasting_Notes: Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a
Process: called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this
Desc: Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a process called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this. This blend is made in micro batches and each batch is processed in a fully sealed vacuum chamber without the presence of any oxygen. It took us months of tweaking to perfect our process and we call the product Bubble Bliss. The name is a riff on the process, as it was processed in a bubble, as some would say! Bubble Bliss has a very sweet aroma and tastes almost like chocolate with a hint of raisins. It brews a flavour balanced cup every time, this is for those who love consistency. Bubble Bliss is made with 100% shade-grown, single origin, AAA Grade Arabica. Available as whole beans or ground for your choice of equipment. Perfect for those who appreciate complex and balanced flavors, this blend is available in various grind options to suit your brewing method.

Name: Baarbara Estate - Honey Sundried Processed
Tasting_Notes: Expect a bright, fruity aroma with notes of berries , a rounded body , and a lingering sweetness
Desc: Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed Arabica Single Origin | Medium Roast | Limited Estate Release Nestled in the misty heights of the Western Ghats, Baarbara Estate is a third-generation coffee plantation run by the Indavara family , proud cultivators of coffee since 1896 under MG Plantations . With over 120 years of heritage and a deep-rooted commitment to sustainability, the estate is certified by both UTZ and the Rainforest Alliance . At elevations ranging from 3,850 to 5,350 feet , this estate produces exceptional Selection 795 Arabica , shade-grown in rich biodiversity. The result is a coffee that truly reflects the unique terroir of Chikmagalur , near the sacred foothills of Bababudan Giri India’s coffee cradle. At Korebi Coffee, we collaborate closely with estates like Baarbara to develop a roast that captures the estate’s unique character and natural expression . This year’s release is a Honey Processed lot, using a time-intensive and flavor-rich technique. ☀️ About the Honey Sun-Dried Process: In the honey process , freshly pulped beans are left with some of their sticky mucilage intact and then sun-dried on raised beds . This method named for the golden, honey-like texture of the drying beans enhances the coffee’s natural sweetness and fruity depth , while preserving the clarity and balance of a washed coffee. It’s a labor of love that results in a cup with exceptional character. ☕ Tasting Notes: Expect a bright, fruity aroma with notes of berries , a rounded body , and a lingering sweetness . The medium roast preserves the vibrant complexity of the honey process while delivering a smooth, balanced finish. Name: The Bourbon - Limited Edition
Tasting_Notes: Tennessee Whiskey resulting in an exciting and unique drinking experience
Desc: The beans are hand rolled daily to ensure all the coffee comes into contact with the oak barrel over the course of several weeks. It is the perfect complement to some sweet dessert. We hail from a dry state, so no alcohol! The green beans have absorbed beautiful bourbon aromas and flavors of Tennessee Whiskey resulting in an exciting and unique drinking experience. These beans are alcohol free, as any alcohol residue from the aging process is evaporated off during roasting. All the whiskey you can taste is flavor only. This is a small batch, limited edition project, sold in limited quantities. By using single origin 100% arabica beans we have created a really well balanced smooth coffee, true but delicate flavors of bourbon run through this drink leaving a sweet dark chocolate liqueur coffee. You can taste the barrels in the aroma, with a rush of blackcurrant and forest fruits. The taste is funky, sweet, rich & smooth. We suggest an Iced Pour Over or a Cold Brew for peak taste experience. Perfect for a special dessert coffee experience, this limited edition blend offers a rich and unique flavor profile.

Name: Kanabi - Limited Edition (Hemp Seed Oil Coffee)
Tasting_Notes: Korebi Coffee
Process: incorporates hemp in the early stages of
Desc: Korebi Coffee Roasters is proud to introduce Kanabi, India's first organic vijaya seed oil coffee, made in collaboration with Cannarma . Hemp is a rich source of nutrients, including protein, omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, fiber, and other beneficial compounds that offer a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving heart health, and promoting overall well-being. Combining vijaya and coffee offers a unique set of benefits. Vijaya seed oil natural properties help counteract some of the negative side effects of caffeine, such as jitters or anxiety, while coffee may enhance alertness and focus. Moreover, the blend of vijaya and coffee provides a more sustained and balanced energy boost compared to coffee alone. Kanabi is crafted from 100% Arabica beans sourced from a single origin. Our unique infusion process incorporates hemp in the early stages of roasting to deliver a distinctive nutty flavor. Infused with hemp seed oil, it provides numerous health benefits, including protein, omega-3, and omega-6 fatty acids. Designed to counteract caffeine's side effects, Kanabi delivers a balanced energy boost. Experience a unique and healthy coffee journey with Kanabi.

Name: Origami Coffee Paper Filters, Cone Shaped, Disposable, 100 Count, Made in Japan
Tasting_Notes: the same coffee can be different depending on the type of paper filter used
Desc: Available in 2 Sizes - -> 1 - 2 Cups (Compatible with Origami Dripper Small (S) & Origami Dripper Air Small (AS)) -> 2 - 4 Cups (Compatible with Origami Dripper Medium (M) & Origami Dripper Air Medium (AM)) ORIGAMI's cone paper filters are characterized by a deep crease and sufficient thickness. When using the conical shape, which has a thicker layer of coffee powder than the wave shape, there is a difference in the extraction of the upper and lower layers of powder. This gives the extracted coffee a more complicated flavor. The taste of the same coffee can be different depending on the type of paper filter used. ORIGAMI drippers feature the ability to use two types of paper filters: cone and wave. The different shapes of the paper used will bring about different changes in the taste of the coffee extracted. Achieve a perfect cup of coffee with our Paper Filter Cone. Designed for optimal flavor extraction, these high-quality filters ensure a clean and smooth brew every time. We hope you enjoy the taste with the conical filters !

Name: Kanabi - Limited Edition (Hemp Seed Oil Coffee)
Tasting_Notes: Korebi Coffee
Process: incorporates hemp in the early stages of
Desc: Korebi Coffee Roasters is proud to introduce Kanabi, India's first organic vijaya seed oil coffee, made in collaboration with Cannarma . Hemp is a rich source of nutrients, including protein, omega-3 and omega-6 fatty acids, fiber, and other beneficial compounds that offer a range of health benefits such as reducing inflammation, improving heart health, and promoting overall well-being. Combining vijaya and coffee offers a unique set of benefits. Vijaya seed oil natural properties help counteract some of the negative side effects of caffeine, such as jitters or anxiety, while coffee may enhance alertness and focus. Moreover, the blend of vijaya and coffee provides a more sustained and balanced energy boost compared to coffee alone. Kanabi is crafted from 100% Arabica beans sourced from a single origin. Our unique infusion process incorporates hemp in the early stages of roasting to deliver a distinctive nutty flavor. Infused with hemp seed oil, it provides numerous health benefits, including protein, omega-3, and omega-6 fatty acids. Designed to counteract caffeine's side effects, Kanabi delivers a balanced energy boost. Experience a unique and healthy coffee journey with Kanabi.

Name: The Bourbon - Limited Edition
Tasting_Notes: Tennessee Whiskey resulting in an exciting and unique drinking experience
Desc: The beans are hand rolled daily to ensure all the coffee comes into contact with the oak barrel over the course of several weeks. It is the perfect complement to some sweet dessert. We hail from a dry state, so no alcohol! The green beans have absorbed beautiful bourbon aromas and flavors of Tennessee Whiskey resulting in an exciting and unique drinking experience. These beans are alcohol free, as any alcohol residue from the aging process is evaporated off during roasting. All the whiskey you can taste is flavor only. This is a small batch, limited edition project, sold in limited quantities. By using single origin 100% arabica beans we have created a really well balanced smooth coffee, true but delicate flavors of bourbon run through this drink leaving a sweet dark chocolate liqueur coffee. You can taste the barrels in the aroma, with a rush of blackcurrant and forest fruits. The taste is funky, sweet, rich & smooth. We suggest an Iced Pour Over or a Cold Brew for peak taste experience. Perfect for a special dessert coffee experience, this limited edition blend offers a rich and unique flavor profile.

Name: Baarbara Estate - Honey Sundried Processed
Tasting_Notes: Expect a bright, fruity aroma with notes of berries , a rounded body , and a lingering sweetness
Desc: Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed Arabica Single Origin | Medium Roast | Limited Estate Release Nestled in the misty heights of the Western Ghats, Baarbara Estate is a third-generation coffee plantation run by the Indavara family , proud cultivators of coffee since 1896 under MG Plantations . With over 120 years of heritage and a deep-rooted commitment to sustainability, the estate is certified by both UTZ and the Rainforest Alliance . At elevations ranging from 3,850 to 5,350 feet , this estate produces exceptional Selection 795 Arabica , shade-grown in rich biodiversity. The result is a coffee that truly reflects the unique terroir of Chikmagalur , near the sacred foothills of Bababudan Giri India’s coffee cradle. At Korebi Coffee, we collaborate closely with estates like Baarbara to develop a roast that captures the estate’s unique character and natural expression . This year’s release is a Honey Processed lot, using a time-intensive and flavor-rich technique. ☀️ About the Honey Sun-Dried Process: In the honey process , freshly pulped beans are left with some of their sticky mucilage intact and then sun-dried on raised beds . This method named for the golden, honey-like texture of the drying beans enhances the coffee’s natural sweetness and fruity depth , while preserving the clarity and balance of a washed coffee. It’s a labor of love that results in a cup with exceptional character. ☕ Tasting Notes: Expect a bright, fruity aroma with notes of berries , a rounded body , and a lingering sweetness . The medium roast preserves the vibrant complexity of the honey process while delivering a smooth, balanced finish. Key Features: 100% Arabica | Single Origin | Shade Grown Honey Sun-Dried for Sweet, Fruit-Forward Notes Ethically Sourced | UTZ & Rainforest Alliance Certified Handpicked at High Elevation (3850–5350 ft) Available as Whole Bean or Freshly Ground Perfect for those who seek sweet, nuanced, and expertly processed coffee , Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed is

Name: Bubble Bliss - Anaerobic Fermented
Tasting_Notes: Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a
Process: called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this
Desc: Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a process called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this. This blend is made in micro batches and each batch is processed in a fully sealed vacuum chamber without the presence of any oxygen. It took us months of tweaking to perfect our process and we call the product Bubble Bliss. The name is a riff on the process, as it was processed in a bubble, as some would say! Bubble Bliss has a very sweet aroma and tastes almost like chocolate with a hint of raisins. It brews a flavour balanced cup every time, this is for those who love consistency. Bubble Bliss is made with 100% shade-grown, single origin, AAA Grade Arabica. Available as whole beans or ground for your choice of equipment. Perfect for those who appreciate complex and balanced flavors, this blend is available in various grind options to suit your brewing method.
